verdict.rationale: Jeeves Cash accounts advertise up to 5% yield on multi-currency balances. The global-accounts page places that yield in the same digital account used to issue cards and pay bills, so operating cash earns yield without moving to a separate institution. Missing for 10: details behind the asterisked 'up to 5%' (rate tiers, eligible currencies or balances, conditions), any explanation of how the yield is generated or custodied, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
